title: Leather tabs and less scrolling
notes: The brown leather tab bar is back.
This Week is split into sub-tabs: Today, To do, City board and News. To do shows one group of actions at a time (Make music, Get out there, Business and so on).
Less scrolling everywhere: on every screen the main cards stay open and the extra ones fold into tap-to-open sections. Tap a title to open it. The game remembers which ones you left open.
